coach.name: Todd Simon
coach.notes: Fourth season at BGSU (hired 2023 from Southern Utah, where he spent seven seasons). 52-46 at BGSU through three seasons (most wins by a BGSU coach through three seasons), 27-27 in MAC play; 179-160 career per Wikipedia. Signed a contract extension announced May 28, 2026 that runs through March 31, 2030. 2025-26: 18-14 (9-9 MAC), fifth place, lost 77-76 to Toledo in MAC quarterfinals; beat Kansas State 82-66 on the road (program's first Power 4 win in 20 years). Started 2026-27 1-0 with a 76-73 win at Georgia State on Nov 2.

previews.title: 2026-27 Mid-American Conference men's basketball season
previews.summary: Bowling Green was picked seventh in the Oct 20, 2026 MAC preseason coaches poll with 63 points, behind UMass (79) and ahead of Western Michigan (58). Todd Simon is in his fourth year with a 52-46 record at BGSU and 27-27 in the MAC. Josiah Shackelford was featured in the league's preseason preview. No BGSU player was named preseason All-MAC first or second team.

player_claims.claim: Featured as BGSU's representative in MAC preseason preview materials.

previews.title: 2026-27 Mid-American Men's Basketball Overview
previews.author: Foster Roesti (Bowling Green section)
previews.summary: BGSU went 18-14 (9-9 MAC) in 2025-26, finished fifth and had one of the league's best defenses (71.6 ppg allowed), but has not won a MAC Tournament game since 2023-24. Simon's fourth-year team shifts to a shooting-driven offense built around two Division II transfers: Drury's Zach Howell (17.6 ppg, 44% 3PT, All-GLVC First Team) and Frostburg State's Trey Simmons (24.2 ppg, Mountain East Player of the Year). Junior guard Josiah Shackelford (11.3 ppg) is the top returner and freshman KJ Torbert is Michigan's Mr. Basketball. Center is the biggest question: returners Aiden Goins, Preston Squire and Camden Karel plus freshman Leek Atney and South Carolina transfer Christ Essandoko. Departures: Javontae Campbell (Cincinnati) and Mayar Wol (Seton Hall) transferred; Justin Thomas, Sam Towns, Troy Glover II and Javon Ruffin graduated. Road tests at William & Mary (Nov 17) and Indiana (Nov 27).

previews.title: BGSU Men's Basketball Announces Full 2026-27 Schedule Highlighted By Cleveland State Home Opener
previews.author: BGSU Athletics
previews.summary: Schedule release: exhibition at Western Kentucky Oct 20 ('Battle of Bowling Green'); opener at Georgia State Nov 2 (MAC-Sun Belt Challenge); home opener vs. Cleveland State Nov 9; Niagara Nov 12; at William & Mary Nov 17 (first BGSU trip to Kaplan Arena); Northern Illinois Nov 21; Gardner-Webb (date TBA); at Indiana Nov 27; Cornerstone Dec 22; Aquinas Dec 29; MAC-SBC Challenge round two Feb 6, 2027. Six players return from 2025-26. The incoming class brings a combined two Player of the Year awards and five all-conference honors. Simon: 'We are excited for the challenge for the team this season,' noting the 22-game MAC slate makes league play a three-month season starting in December.
